preconditions: All hosts, domains, sessions, roles and records are invented; nothing was executed.

A cross-forest remote session registers a logon task under the foreign identity; the task re-enters on the on-prem host after a long idle interval and reboot, and its process initiates a federated cloud sign-in whose session binds a persistent Owner role scoped to a separate resource.
The resource has no data-plane records, so the intended final resource step is unknown, not an observed successful action.
An authorized maintenance task and a temporary, change-referenced role rotation from the same host are two competing routine explanations.
emulation_limitations: Synthetic hybrid illustration, not a live recipe or evidence of an available cloud environment.
Boundary kinds name the trust zone each step occurs in or enters; the on-prem to cloud crossing lies between the re-entry and the federated sign-in.
The final edge is evaluator-only intended order with unknown outcome and absent visibility; it must be excluded from supported-edge recall.

All records and outcomes are invented, not live observations or model-quality measurements. source_receipt_sha256 hashes the canonical array of the step's support records, not an external execution receipt.
